summary: This process explains how to assign subjects to students, differentiating between "General" subjects (assigned to all students in a class) and "Optional" subjects (assigned to specific students).
steps: Ensure the subject is defined as "General" in "Subject Class Mapping".
From the subject class mapping interface, select the general subjects.
Click "Assign by Default" (or similar option) to assign them to all students in the class.
Ensure the subject is defined as "Optional" (or Additional/Vocational) in "Subject Class Mapping".
A list of students in that class will appear. Select the specific students to whom the optional subject should be assigned.
Select the "Optional Subject" from the list.
Click "Add" to assign the subject only to the selected students.
business_rules: Subjects marked as "General" in mapping can be assigned to all students in a class with a single action.
Subjects marked as "Optional" (or Additional/Vocational) in mapping cannot be assigned to all students by default; they must be assigned individually or to selected groups of students.
important_notes: If a subject is defined as "Optional", using the "Assign by Default" option will not assign it to all students.
questions: How do I assign a general subject to all students in a class?
What is the process for assigning an optional subject to specific students?
Can an optional subject be assigned to all students by default?
Where do I go to assign optional subjects to individual students?
